purpose_context: Deliver a narrow Phase 2 vertical slice through the tracker port using Beads v1.2.2's supported versioned JSON CLI contract. Preserve kernel isolation, immutable WorkRevision execution, lease-scoped workspaces, independent review, serialized integration, and attribution-safe compensation under slow, unavailable, stale, and human-modified provider state. The mission deliberately excludes Beads identity, Molecules, Git hooks, merge authority, and human-output parsing.
purpose_tldr: Make Beads the default work catalog without transferring execution, review, or integration authority out of Spec Kitty.
